critical_code_review_comments: sap_analytics.py is a clean 402-line module — good split. sap_uac.py is still large; carrying-over comment from iter 70: continue peeling ownership-domain slices out to keep modules <700 lines.

SodCommandCenter.jsx went 836 -> 640 lines with 4 child extractions — good. As with GovernanceDigestCard in iter 70, the new child cards are auto-computed prop pass-through; consider consolidating parent state into a single object + setter to reduce brittle prop drilling.
SodWatchlist.jsx still syncs via window CustomEvent 'sap-watchlist-changed' (flagged in iter 70). Same recommendation: shared context / lightweight store.
